en.title: Anagram Difference
en.description: For each pair of lowercase strings, find the minimum number of characters to replace on either side to make them anagrams; return −1 if their lengths differ.
en.input: The first line contains q (1≤q≤100); each test case gives two strings: first |a| and |b|, then each string on its own line. An empty string is written as a line containing only -; non-empty strings contain only a-z, with length≤10000.
en.output: For each test case, output one line with the minimum number of replacements; output −1 if the lengths differ.
en.explanation: Derive a linear-scan/dynamic-programming solution directly from the problem rules; the examples have been checked case by case against an independently built oracle.
hints: First turn the operations or constraints in the statement into a concrete array/state transition, then analyze the edge cases.
